<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-1601-48-39" status="unreviewed"><milestone n="a. jo btsun, 'bum phrag" unit="section"/>
            yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">jo btsun</rs> dang  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'buM phrag</rs> 2 pa na re laM zhes pa ni laM dga' zehs pas phyin par byed pa yin pas tshogs laM la so pa nas mya nan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du phyin par yed pa'i phyir laM yin zhing | mthar phyin pa'i laM ni phyin zin pa <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="194b9"/> yin pas laM btags pa ba yin zhes zer ro | 
 <milestone n="b. mu tra" unit="section"/>
            yang  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3811">mu tra</rs> na re mthong laM dang bsgoM laM dang bcas phyin pa'i la 2 ni chos nyid mngon suM du rtogs pas
            la <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> pa yin la | shes pa dang sbyor ba ni la btags pa ba yino zhes zer ro || 
 <milestone n="c. 'ban" unit="section"/>
            yang  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> na re la lnga ga la <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> pa yin te mthar phyin pa'i ma la yang phung po lhag bcas nas
            lhag Na kyi mya ngan las 'das par phyed par byed cing | bar rdzogs pa'i byang yub du
            'gyur ba'i nyan thos 
         <pb n="389"/>
 
            <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="195a1"/> rnaM pas sangs rgyas gyi sar phyin par byed pas laM mtshan nyid pa yin no zhes zer ro ||
             <milestone n="d. rngog lo tsa ba" unit="section"/>
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog lo tsa ba</rs> yang laM lnga ka laM mtshan nyid par 'do de | 'og du bshad par bya'o ||</seg></TEI>
